content.label: Every parent asks
content.question: What if you fall sick there?

answers.title: Understand insurance
answers.detail: Know what the policy covers and how a claim works. Explain it to Mum and Dad too.

answers.title: Know the health centre
answers.detail: Save your university's health services address and number in advance.

answers.title: Stock your medicines
answers.detail: Carry your regular medicines and prescriptions. Check the rules for carrying them first.
